name: The Dark Mile
$comment: The term's crisis (docs/systems-05-crisis-storylines.md, crisis 1): the Cahokia line goes quiet past the Shenandoah ruin. Omen until Lesson 5 is walked; Pressure after it; Crisis with the field open; the Reckoning at the Gate. Three Ledgers; weight comes from quests done (by the type that serves a Ledger and the line colour), from a Writ's decision, and from the crisis postings. The heaviest Ledger with a quarter of the weight wins, else the default. An ending writes the world onto the character for the server.

relit.name: Relit by the guilds
relit.text: The Compact and the guilds relight the mile themselves and keep it.

abandoned.name: Abandoned to the water
abandoned.text: The mile is given up; what was in the ruin is carried out, and the river keeps the rest.

carroll.name: Claimed by House Carroll
carroll.text: House Carroll relights the mile under its own lamps and its own toll.

notices.omen: The Compact's notice: the Cahokia line runs slow past the Shenandoah ruin. No Ledger is open yet. Listen on Mondays.
notices.pressure: The Ledgers are open on the Dark Mile. Every posting that serves one weighs it; the Compact reads them on Wednesdays.
notices.crisis: The Dark Mile is at its crisis. The crisis postings weigh three times; the Reckoning is read at the Gate.
notices.reckoning: The Ledgers are closed. The Reckoning was read at the Gate.

crisisQuests.title: The Dark Mile: relight the crossing
crisisQuests.posting: CRISIS. The Compact asks every hall for hands: the crossing at the mile wants relighting before the water takes the ballast. Weighs the Relit Ledger threefold.

crisisQuests.title: The Dark Mile: carry out the Archive's last
crisisQuests.posting: CRISIS. The Archive will not hold the mile; it wants what is in the ruin carried out before it is given up. Weighs the Abandoned Ledger threefold.

crisisQuests.title: The Dark Mile: House Carroll's writ
crisisQuests.posting: CRISIS. House Carroll has a writ for the crossing's lamps and will pay in Favour and Notes. Weighs the Carroll Ledger threefold; the decision at the end weighs more.

crisisQuests.title: The Dark Mile: what sleeps in the hull
crisisQuests.posting: CRISIS. The river towns want the Barge-Heart felled whatever becomes of the line. Weighs the Abandoned Ledger threefold.

crisisQuests.title: The Dark Mile: Carroll's surveyor
crisisQuests.posting: CRISIS. House Carroll's surveyor must reach the ruin's post to mark the lamps. Weighs the Carroll Ledger threefold.

crisisQuests.title: The Dark Mile: to the hull and back
crisisQuests.posting: CRISIS. Varga's posting: the river line to its heart in one run, for the guilds' relighting. Weighs the Relit Ledger threefold.

relit.title: The mile is relit
relit.text: At the Reckoning the Relit Ledger stood heaviest. The guilds took the Dark Mile back post by post; the Cahokia line runs through to the west, and no house owns its lamps. Enoch Vane was never found, and House Carroll remembers who relit the mile without it.
relit.chronicle: The Thaw of the Hundred-and-Fourth Cohort: the Dark Mile relit by the guilds.

abandoned.title: The mile is given up
abandoned.text: At the Reckoning no Ledger carried the day, or the Abandoned one did: the Compact let the Dark Mile go. Cahokia is reached by airship this year; the ruin is sealed; what the Archive carried out is in its vaults. The river towns say the Barge-Heart is dead, and say it quietly.
abandoned.chronicle: The Thaw of the Hundred-and-Fourth Cohort: the Dark Mile abandoned to the water.

carroll.title: The mile is Carroll's
carroll.text: At the Reckoning the Carroll Ledger stood heaviest. House Carroll relit the Dark Mile under its own lamps and its own toll; the line runs, and every car that runs it pays. Enoch Vane was taken at the crossing. The Compact signed, and the Commons said it would remember the signature.
carroll.chronicle: The Thaw of the Hundred-and-Fourth Cohort: the Dark Mile claimed by House Carroll.
